content.title: Rory McIlroy family tree: Meet wife Erica, daughter Poppy, parents, more to know about golf star's Northern Ireland roots
content.text: Rory McIlroy family tree: Meet wife Erica, daughter Poppy, parents, more to know about golf star's Northern Ireland roots originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.Rory McIlroy has millions of fans across the United States, Northern Ireland and the world, but a few close confidants have stayed by his side through the ups and downs of his career.Aside from his many friends in the game of golf, McIlroy has leaned heavily on his parents and the rest of his immediate family as he chased a return to glory during his long majors drought.Here's a look at the family behind McIlroy, including his wife and parents.MORE: Rory McIlroy joins rare list as back-to-back Masters championsRory McIlroy wife: Erica StollMcIlroy has been married to Erica Stoll since early 2017. The two welcomed a daughter in 2020.Stoll, a former PGA of America office manager, met McIlroy through her job at the 2012 Ryder Cup. "Erica that week was always the one that was checking us in and out. She was there at transportation, so she was always in the car park over there," McIlroy told Golf Channel about the time he met her. McIlroy was dating tennis star Caroline Wozniacki at the time, but the two broke up not long after.McIlroy and Stoll ran into issues in their relationship in 2024. After McIlroy filed for divorce in early 2024, the two reconnected in the middle of the year and announced they would remain married. Stoll was recently seen with McIlroy at the Par 3 Contest ahead of the Masters.McIlroy said on Netflix series "Full Swing" that the near-divorce came after he "struggled with trying to be the best golfer, the best husband, the best dad." While he declined to go into more detail about his personal life, McIlroy took the blame and remains married to Stoll.Rory McIlroy daughter: Poppy McIlroyMcIlroy's only daughter, Poppy, was born on Aug. 31, 2020, and has been by her father's side for many of his biggest moments in recent years.After Poppy's birth, McIlroy said there was "nothing like it in the world" when asked about how fatherhood felt. "It's probably the best part of being a human being, and I'm glad that I got to experience it," he told Golfweek.If Poppy's early performances at the Masters Par 3 contest are any indication, she could have a future in golf herself:MORE: What to know about Rory McIlroy's Northern Ireland rootsRory McIlroy father: Gerry McIlroyMcIlroy has a close relationship with his father, Gerry, who once cleaned bathrooms and worked as a bartender among his multiple jobs to help support his son. One of Gerry's jobs was at Holywood Golf Club, where McIlroy worked toward a professional golf career.While his son is the star, Gerry is a golfer himself and was seen getting out on the course with Rory before the 2026 Masters:While his son is the star, Gerry is a golfer himself and was seen getting outGerry is described as a source of positivity for the often emotional McIlroy, even after working long hours to make his son's dream possible. "We didn't take a family holiday for over a decade," McIlroy said of his parents in 2017.Rory McIlroy mother: Rosie McIlroyMcIlroy's mother, Rosie, also has a close relationship with her son, but she is described as the tougher of the two. She held down a factory job and made sure her son didn't stray from the path that would help him achieve his golf dreams.Rosie married Gerry in 1988, and the two remain the biggest public and private supporters of their son, even as he has gathered a massive fan base.MORE: Complete list of Masters winners by yearWhere is Rory McIlroy from?McIlroy was born and raised in Holywood, County Down, Northern Ireland. While he is now a global superstar, McIlroy can still find his most ardent supporters back home in Northern Ireland as he continues to add onto his remarkable legacy.
